name: status: needs-triage
description: New issue: type, priority and difficulty still to confirm

name: status: needs-decision
description: Product decision expected before coding

name: status: ready
description: Triaged, intent complete: can be claimed

name: status: claimed
description: A session claimed the issue (comment `/claim <id>`, released by `/release`)

name: status: blocked
description: Waits on something that can be named and will end (lot, capture, access): a `### Blocked by` section says what

name: status: on-hold
description: Held by a decision (milestone not open, operator's call), not by a dependency

name: type: bug
description: Incorrect behaviour or crash

name: type: feature
description: New feature or improvement

name: type: docs
description: README, docs/, CLAUDE.md, diagrams

name: type: chore
description: Workflows, tooling, quality, repository settings, release

name: type: security
description: Flaw or hardening (never any public detail: SECURITY.md)

name: type: epic
description: Umbrella issue with sub-issues: lot (LOT-NNN in the title) or test feedback to triage

name: priority: critical
description: Data loss or crash: before anything else

name: priority: high
description: Blocking or wrong result

name: priority: medium
description: Important, next iteration

name: priority: low
description: Comfort, later

name: difficulty: trivial
description: Local or mechanical change, full spec in the issue. Fast model tier

name: difficulty: easy
description: A few files, state, persistence, layout. Solid model tier

name: difficulty: medium
description: Engine, business rules, security, architecture, research. Strong model tier

name: difficulty: hard
description: Structural decision or riskiest problem. Frontier model tier, reviewed by another

name: needs: host
description: Needs the operator's machine (Xcode, simulator, device, captures): not for cloud sessions

name: needs: info
description: Waiting for information from the reporter

name: needs: review
description: Waiting for a review (adversarial, compliance or human)

name: direct-pr
description: PR without an issue (small fix, Direct-PR: line): counted for tracking

name: dependencies
description: Dependency update (Dependabot)
